actual_capital_classification.confirmed_actual_capital: Aviva reports GBP 50 million invested in a tokenized share class of its Sterling Liquidity Fund.
actual_capital_classification.not_xrp_capital: The GBP 50 million is fund-share investment, not XRP purchases or XRP collateral.
actual_capital_classification.customer_asset_balance: Coinbase's USD 22 billion average USDC held is a customer/product balance measure, not new XRP capital.

hypotheses.statement: Coinbase's RLUSD listing increases access and potential stablecoin liquidity on XRPL.
disconfirming_evidence: No deposit/withdrawal volumes or RLUSD balances disclosed.
RLUSD can be used on Base and Ethereum as well as XRPL; the announcement does not allocate activity by network.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure XRPL RLUSD issued supply, exchange hot/cold balances, trustline activity, transfer counterparties and Coinbase-tagged deposits/withdrawals.

hypotheses.statement: Coinbase's RLUSD support may diversify stablecoin distribution and compete with USDC balances in some use cases.
disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase reports record USD 22 billion average USDC held and material USDC economics; no USDC replacement or share loss is disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Compare RLUSD and USDC balances, flows, fees, network mix and product placement before and after listing.

hypotheses.statement: Aviva's tokenized GBP liquidity-fund share class adds institutional RWA activity on XRPL.
disconfirming_evidence: The structure is a digital twin with underlying fund assets off-chain.
The GBP 50 million investment is in fund shares, not XRP; no XRP units or material fee totals are disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Track token issuance/redemptions, eligible-holder count, transfer volume, repeat subscriptions, XRPL fees and secondary liquidity.

hypotheses.statement: Standard Chartered's live RLUSD custody plus planned LMAX collateral mirroring could support institutional RLUSD collateral workflows.
disconfirming_evidence: Collateral use remains conditional and is not live at the capture cutoff.
No client balances, collateral amounts or trading volumes are disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Require official launch notice, eligible-product schedule, custody balances and actual collateral usage.

hypotheses.statement: SBI is pursuing both Ripple/XRPL/RLUSD and Circle/USDC/Arc rails rather than an exclusive XRP strategy.
disconfirming_evidence: The relationships are in different subsidiaries and products; no disclosed group-wide capital allocation or exclusivity policy.
hypotheses.next_test: Track actual settlement volumes, customers, balances, cross-network interoperability and group-level investment allocation.

hypotheses.statement: SBI accumulation, card rewards and points redemption can create recurring XRP customer credits and potential demand.
disconfirming_evidence: No XRP-specific subscriber counts, selection share, credited units or inventory source are disclosed.
Rewards may be fulfilled from existing inventory or OTC rather than contemporaneous spot purchases.
hypotheses.next_test: Obtain aggregate XRP conversions, customer selections, inventory reconciliations and executed market/OTC purchase records.

hypotheses.statement: The effective Ripple National Trust Bank charter may strengthen institutional confidence in Ripple's regulated operating infrastructure.
disconfirming_evidence: The OCC record does not establish general deposit-taking, XRP reserves, XRP collateral or token demand.
hypotheses.next_test: Review approved activities, operating launch, custody products, regulatory filings and any explicit XRP-related service.
